description: Post each new ticket an engineering agent filed (GitHub Issues with a given label, and/or Linear issues in a given team) to Slack with a short excerpt, once.

slack_channel.label: Slack Channel
slack_channel.description: Channel to announce new tickets in (either `C123ABC456` id or `#channel-name`).

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's `xoxb-...` token. Needs `chat:write`.

excerpt_chars.label: Excerpt Chars
excerpt_chars.description: Max characters of the ticket body quoted in the Slack message.

repo.label: Repo
repo.description: GitHub repository to watch for agent-filed issues, 'owner/repo'. Leave unset to skip GitHub.

github_token_env_var.label: Github Token Env Var
github_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a GitHub token with read access to issues.

github_issue_label.label: Github Issue Label
github_issue_label.description: Only issues carrying this label are announced.

linear_team_id.label: Linear Team Id
linear_team_id.description: Linear team UUID to watch for agent-filed tickets. Leave unset to skip Linear.

linear_api_key_env_var.label: Linear Api Key Env Var
linear_api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a Linear API key.

linear_marker.label: Linear Marker
linear_marker.description: Only Linear issues whose description contains this exact marker text are announced.

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Chat platform to announce new tickets in. 'teams' posts via Microsoft Graph instead of Slack.

teams_team_id.label: Teams Team Id
teams_team_id.description: platform='teams' (required then). Teams team id (Teams client -> team -> ... -> Get link).

teams_channel_id.label: Teams Channel Id
teams_channel_id.description: platform='teams' (required then). Teams channel id inside the team (e.g. '19:xxx@thread.tacv2').

teams_tenant_id_env_var.label: Teams Tenant Id Env Var
teams_tenant_id_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD tenant id.

teams_client_id_env_var.label: Teams Client Id Env Var
teams_client_id_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client id.

teams_client_secret_env_var.label: Teams Client Secret Env Var
teams_client_secret_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client secret.

teams_refresh_token_env_var.label: Teams Refresh Token Env Var
teams_refresh_token_env_var.description: platform='teams'. Env var holding the OAuth refresh token.
